label: QMD vertical (talking-head short)
principles: The scene plan is approved before anything is built. A technical check is not an approval.
The speaker stays on screen for the whole piece, large, with the body running off the bottom. A landscape panel sits behind the torso and the head breaks its top edge.
Every join changes the zoom. The speaker scale stays at or under 1.19. Transitions land in speech pauses. Speech is never stretched and pauses are never added.

The ground keeps moving (gradient blobs, topo, dots, a light beam, grain). Grain sits under the speaker, never on the face. Render frames are PNG so the browser only downscales the pre-scaled cut-out.
A filter tween never starts at brightness 0 or at the keyword none: GSAP fills the missing brightness with 0 and the speaker flashes as a black silhouette.
The cut-out is an RVM matte with motion-compensated temporal smoothing, a 1 px choke, an edge-only feather, colour decontamination and a light wrap, plus a static contact shadow.
Hero numbers, logos and UI are real and credited. No disclaimer chip and no invented figure.
The outro is the brand lockup and the domain only, held a few seconds after the last word. No CTA line. Deliver both 1080x1920 and 1920x1080 from the same markup.
One mixed track: voice at least 12 dB over the music in 300-3500 Hz, integrated loudness -14 LUFS, true peak at or under -1 dBTP.
